steps.text:
<Canvas>
<Columns>
<Column>
<Heading>Factor it</Heading>
<Text tone="muted">Find two numbers: product 5, sum -6.</Text>
<Equations>x^2 - 6x + 5 &= 0 \\ (x-1)(x-5) &= 0 \\ x = 1 \quad &\text{or} \quad x = 5</Equations>
</Column>
<Column>
<Heading>Quadratic formula</Heading>
<Text tone="muted">a = 1, b = -6, c = 5.</Text>
<Equations>x &= \frac{6 \pm \sqrt{36 - 20}}{2} \\ x &= \frac{6 \pm 4}{2} \\ x = 1 \quad &\text{or} \quad x = 5</Equations>
</Column>
</Columns>
<Panel x={700} y={720} w={520}>
<Plot fn="x^2 - 6*x + 5" xmin={-1} xmax={7} points="1,0; 5,0" label="roots at x = 1 and x = 5"/>
</Panel>
<Note kind="check">Both methods give the same roots: x = 1 and x = 5.</Note>
</Canvas>
